hotspot.title: Hotspot
hotspot.hint: Make this computer its own Wi-Fi when there is no usable network. Phones join it, then scan the QR code above.
hotspot.qr_alt: QR code to join the Wi-Fi {ssid}
hotspot.qr_caption: Scan with the phone's camera to join the Wi-Fi.
hotspot.qr_hint: Enter the hotspot's name and password (as set in the system settings) to show a QR code for joining it.
hotspot.error.invalid_ssid: The network name must be 1–32 characters.
hotspot.error.invalid_password: The password must be 8–63 characters without spaces.
hotspot.error.unsupported: This computer cannot start a hotspot from here.
hotspot.guide.windows.1: Open Settings → Network & internet → Mobile hotspot.
hotspot.guide.windows.2: Choose “Share over Wi-Fi” and set a network name and password (Edit).
hotspot.guide.windows.3: Turn Mobile hotspot on. midnightsnack shows the new address (usually 192.168.137.1) automatically.
hotspot.guide.windows.4: Phones join the Wi-Fi, then scan the QR code above.
hotspot.guide.macos.2: Click ⓘ next to Internet Sharing; share a connection with Wi-Fi and set the network name and password under Wi-Fi Options.
hotspot.guide.macos.3: Turn Internet Sharing on. midnightsnack picks up the new address automatically.
hotspot.guide.macos.4: Phones join the Wi-Fi, then scan the QR code above.
hotspot.guide.linux.2: Choose “Turn On Wi-Fi Hotspot” (GNOME) or create a shared Wi-Fi connection.
hotspot.guide.linux.3: midnightsnack picks up the new address automatically.
hotspot.guide.linux.4: Phones join the Wi-Fi, then scan the QR code above.
